Working at GE Vernova means collaborating with colleagues who bring varied technical and professional expertise to complex challenges across the energy value chain. The company’s purpose is reflected in its focus on reliability, innovation, and the energy transition. About The Role GE Vernova is seeking a motivated professional to contribute to work that supports the delivery of energy solutions for customers. This opportunity is suited to someone who brings sound judgment, a collaborative approach, and the ability to turn priorities into thoughtful, practical outcomes. The successful candidate will apply their experience and skills to assigned projects, operational activities, or customer engagements, depending on the team’s needs and the individual’s area of expertise. A degree, diploma, certification, or equivalent practical experience may be considered depending on the role. Applicants should be able to demonstrate clear written and verbal communication, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work constructively with colleagues from different functions and backgrounds. Successful candidates will bring a commitment to safety, quality, integrity, and responsible decision-making. They should be comfortable analyzing information, asking thoughtful questions, and adapting when priorities change. Familiarity with relevant tools, technologies, standards, or industry practices is an advantage where applicable. The ability to learn new systems and processes is important. Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to clarify objectives, share information, and support timely completion of work. Prepare, review, or maintain documentation and records with attention to accuracy, quality, and applicable procedures. 9e83cb3dd87c6f4b.description: The Role The Clinical Dietitian is responsible for planning, delivering and evaluating nutrition care services for patients across assigned clinics. You will provide Medical Nutrition Therapy, monitor clinical nutrition parameters, support food service quality and contribute to quality improvement initiatives. You will report to the Clinic Manager and work closely with the Head of Nutrition Care, physicians, nurses and the wider multidisciplinary team What You Will Do Deliver Medical Nutrition Therapy tailored to hemodialysis patients with different backgrounds, age groups and medical conditions. Implement the Nutrition Care Process, including screening, assessment, diagnosis, intervention, counselling, monitoring and evaluation. Identify and manage nutrition-related conditions including malnutrition, protein-energy wasting (PEW), sarcopenia, obesity, diabetes and other chronic conditions. Monitor clinical, biochemical and nutritional parameters and develop individualised nutrition care plans. Utilise digital tools, AI-enabled technologies and body composition assessment devices where available to support nutritional assessment, monitoring and clinical decision-making. Maintain accurate documentation, including Monthly Care Plans, nutritional assessments, follow-ups and referrals. Participate in nutrition audits, quality improvement initiatives and monitoring of nutrition outcome indicators. Collaborate effectively with the multidisciplinary team to support comprehensive patient care. Support the orientation, education and development of dietitians, interns and colleagues. Stay updated on renal nutrition, malnutrition, sarcopenia, digital health and emerging technologies in clinical nutrition Desired Candidate Profile You are clinically precise, patient-focused and forward-thinking. You understand that nutrition in dialysis is complex and requires both strong technical knowledge and effective patient communication. You will be well-suited to this role if you: Deliver evidence-based nutrition care with accuracy and genuine patient focus. Communicate effectively with patients and healthcare professionals. Recognise nutritional risk early and take appropriate action. Are comfortable using digital tools and open to AI and technology-enabled clinical practice. Take initiative in quality improvement and continuous learning. Work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary team. What we need: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What you need to be able to do: Bachelor's degree in Clinical Nutrition. Master's degree is an advantage. Valid SCFHS classification/registration as a Clinical Dietitian Specialist. Fluent in Arabic and English, spoken and written. Proficient in MS Office and basic computer systems. Clinical dietetics experience in a hospital or healthcare setting. What gives you an edge: Experience in renal nutrition, diabetes or chronic disease management. Knowledge of malnutrition, PEW and sarcopenia. Experience with body composition analysis, nutrition assessment technologies or digital clinical tools. Familiarity with HACCP and foodservice management. Experience with nutrition outcome indicators, research or quality improvement projects.

9eac8cc52a182c29.description: About the Role Informa PLC is seeking a Head of Marketing - LIONS Riyadh - Arabic Speaker to lead the brand, audience, and go-to-market strategy for LIONS Riyadh. LIONS Riyadh, launched by Tahaluf in partnership with LIONS and Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Media, is a distinct Festival within the global LIONS community. It aims to amplify Middle Eastern creativity globally, showcasing regional talent and connecting creative industries with leading networks and brands. The inaugural three-day Festival will take place in Riyadh from 6–8 December 2027. Key Responsibilities Develop value propositions and go-to-market strategies in collaboration with commercial leads. Oversee the delivery of marketing campaigns aligned with business objectives, timelines, and budgets. Manage a cross-functional marketing team, fostering creativity and enthusiasm. Build awareness, consideration, and demand for LIONS Riyadh across Saudi Arabia, the GCC, and priority international markets. Drive qualified registrations, ticket sales, and attendance from priority audience segments. Ensure all campaigns reflect the LIONS brand, tone, and creative standards, maximizing impact across paid, owned, and earned channels. Deliver strong digital engagement, conversion, and return on marketing investment. Build an active year-round community around the LIONS Riyadh brand via content marketing. Drive effective collaboration across Marketing, Content, PR, Commercial, Creative, and LIONS teams. Act as a change management ambassador, demonstrating a positive and constructive attitude towards challenges. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in marketing leadership, with a track record of commercial collaboration. Proficiency in Arabic is required. A distinctive combination of brand thinking, creative judgment, audience insight, and commercial marketing expertise. Ability to build desire around a premium global brand while ensuring cultural relevance to Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East. Analytical and data-oriented with experience in testing and optimization, combined with creative flair and attention to detail. Extensive experience in digital marketing, content marketing, and marketing technology. Accustomed to delivering results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Ability to work closely with LIONS, Content, Creative, PR, Commercial, and Partnerships teams. Adaptable to differing market dynamics and capable of guiding marketers and steering campaign strategy accordingly. Team Leadership and Development Line manage senior marketers and specialists across various events, providing guidance, feedback, and inspiration. Build a high-performing, creatively ambitious marketing team capable of delivering to LIONS brand standards. Champion bold thinking, strong creative judgment, and audience-first marketing. Promote the adoption and optimization of marketing technology solutions and digital marketing. Ensure line reports have clear development roadmaps and the necessary skills and training. Data-Driven Strategy and Brand Management Monitor campaign performance, analyze trends, and use data insights to build effective campaigns. Develop a deep understanding of LIONS Riyadh audience segments, motivations, and behaviors across key markets. Track brand awareness, consideration, and perception to ensure relevance and desirability in the market. Oversee the annual marketing calendar and build integrated campaign plans across all channels. Ensure all LIONS Riyadh marketing is creatively distinctive, premium, and consistent with the global LIONS brand, with strong localization for Saudi and regional audiences.

9eea9bac3b828b8c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات عن مهندس كهربائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية، ومتابعة التنفيذ، وتشخيص الأعطال، وتطوير برامج الصيانة للمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الكهربائية، ومتابعة مراحل التنفيذ. تطوير مخططات ومواصفات لخطوط شبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية وتحديد مساراتها. إعداد برامج تشغيل الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية بما يتوافق مع متطلبات العمل. تشخيص أعطال الأجهزة والمعدات الكهربائية ومتابعة إجراءات الإصلاح والصيانة اللازمة. إعداد برامج الصيانة الوقائية للأجهزة والمعدات والشبكات الكهربائية بناءً على توصيات الشركات المصنعة والتعليمات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب تقدمها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهربائية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الكهربائية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بشبكات النقل والتوزيع الكهربائية. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال ووضع حلول للصيانة والإصلاح. مهارات في إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المهندس الكهربائي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة السليمي المتحدة للمقاولات، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة للتطوير المهني. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة لم يتم الكشف عنه، وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى شركة مقاولات رائدة والمساهمة في مشاريعها الهندسية.

9e1815f29be98a1e.description: We are looking for qualified NDT Technicians specializing in Radiographic Testing Film Interpretation (RTFI), Penetrant Testing (PT), or Ultrasonic Testing (UT) to join our PED Division at Salama Engineering. The candidates will be responsible for conducting non-destructive testing and inspection of welds, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and fabricated components to ensure compliance with applicable ASME codes, project specifications, and quality standards. Candidates should have relevant NDT certifications, hands-on experience in fabrication environments, and the ability to perform inspections, evaluate defects, prepare technical reports, and maintain inspection records in accordance with approved procedures and safety requirements. Key Responsibilities: Perform NDT inspections using RTFI, PT, or UT techniques on welds, pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and fabricated components. Identify, evaluate, and report surface and subsurface defects in accordance with approved inspection procedures. Ensure compliance with applicable ASME codes, project specifications, and quality standards. Prepare inspection reports and maintain accurate testing records and documentation. Verify inspection equipment calibration and ensure proper use of testing tools and materials. Coordinate with QC Inspectors, Welding Engineers, and fabrication teams to resolve inspection findings. Follow approved NDT procedures, quality control requirements, and workplace safety standards. Ensure inspection activities are completed within project timelines and meet customer requirements. Qualifications and Experience: Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or a relevant technical qualification; Higher Secondary Certificate may be accepted for PT Technician. Minimum 2–5 years of relevant experience in NDT inspection within pressure vessel, heat exchanger, or heavy fabrication industries. Valid certification in the relevant NDT method: RTFI, PT Level II, or UT Level II, preferably PCN or an equivalent recognized certification. Good knowledge of ASME Section V, applicable inspection standards, and project specifications. Hands-on experience in weld inspection, defect identification, and preparation of NDT reports. Ability to read technical drawings, follow approved inspection procedures, and maintain accurate documentation. Strong attention to detail, quality awareness, and commitment to workplace safety.

9ed8651083713848.description: Job description: Position Overview: Reports To: Program Director Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Employment Type: Full Time Work Arrangement: On-site Application Deadline: 10 November 2026 Role Purpose: We are seeking an experienced Contracts Manager (E1) to lead contract management across DAR Engineering's large-scale projects in Riyadh. The role holds overall responsibility for the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts, from pre-qualification and tendering through to performance monitoring, claims resolution and close-out, protecting the commercial and contractual interests of the project. The successful candidate will bring deep knowledge of engineering and construction contracting practices, sound commercial judgement and the leadership to manage a contracts team and influence senior stakeholders on complex, multi-discipline projects. Key Responsibilities: Hold overall responsibility for contract management on large-scale projects, safeguarding the contractual and commercial interests of the project. Lead the contracts team, including workload distribution, execution of work and personnel management. Manage the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts, including pre-qualification, compilation of bid requests, receipt of bids, bid evaluation and award. Monitor contractor performance against contract requirements, and administer back charges where applicable. Administer and negotiate change orders, including pricing and assessment of cost and time impact. Manage claims and disputes, assessing entitlement, negotiating resolution and escalating where required. Draft and review contract documents, and advise project teams on contract law, obligations and risk. Oversee prime contract administration, and establish the execution office and field procedures and documents needed for a multi-discipline construction project. Prepare clear and effective contract correspondence and notices, and maintain complete contract records. Coordinate planning and scheduling inputs from a contractual perspective, including delay and extension of time matters. Ensure compliance with government and commercial procurement regulations, policies and procedures. Report on contract status, commercial risks and exposures to the Project Director and senior management. Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Business, Quantity Surveying, Law, Engineering, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management or an equivalent degree from an accredited university, with preference for candidates educated in Western countries. Professional qualifications in contract management, quantity surveying or construction law (for example RICS, CIArb or FIDIC contract training) will be an advantage. Experience Requirements: Minimum 17 years of experience in contracts management, including overall responsibility for contract management on large-scale projects. Direct experience of managing workload distribution, execution of work and personnel management. Experience in the formation and administration of contracts and subcontracts: pre-qualification, compilation of bid requests, receipt of bids, bid evaluation, award, monitoring of contractor performance, back charges, and resolution of claims and disputes. Demonstrated experience in pricing, contract law, contract drafting, administration and negotiation of change orders, effective correspondence, planning and scheduling. Experience of working internationally on multi-discipline construction projects; prior experience in Saudi Arabia is preferred. Technical Knowledge: Technical and administrative knowledge of engineering and construction industry contracting practices, government and commercial procurement regulations and practices, policies, procedures and work practices. Thorough knowledge of prime contracts management administration, as well as (sub)contract formation and administration. Thorough knowledge of execution office and field procedures and documents relating to a multi-discipline construction project. Working knowledge of internationally used standard forms of contract, such as FIDIC. Skills and Competencies: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Strong negotiation skills and sound commercial judgement. Leadership and people management skills, with the ability to distribute workload and manage a team. Strong analytical skills, with demonstrated experience in pricing and commercial evaluation. Skilled in contract drafting, effective correspondence and accurate record keeping. Strong planning and scheduling skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities on large-scale projects. Working Hours: We support a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, allowing employees some flexibility in their daily start and finish times, while maintaining a structured working schedule of up to 48 hours per week. What We Offer: The chance to drive growth on landmark projects across Saudi Arabia and the GCC. A collaborative, supportive environment within a leading multidisciplinary consultancy. Competitive salary and benefits, including housing and transportation. Comprehensive healthcare coverage and wellness support. A team that genuinely encourages each other to succeed. A diverse, inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds come together under one shared vision. A culture that celebrates success, values innovation, and builds something bigger together. We believe great work happens as a team. We want people to come in with purpose and leave each day with a sense of accomplishment. To Apply: If you believe you have the skills, knowledge, and experience to fulfil this role, please submit your application online by clicking 'Apply'. Riyadh-based candidates preferred, but relocation support is available for the right talent. DAR Engineering is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, age, marital status, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. What's Next? Once your application has been submitted and reviewed, our Talent Acquisition team will contact shortlisted candidates. Our selection process typically comprises two interview stages per vacancy, ensuring a comprehensive evaluation while providing candidates with the opportunity to engage with two members of the hiring team at each stage. The initial interview is generally conducted virtually, while the final stage often takes place in person at the office, aligning with the role's location. That said, we prioritize flexibility, tailoring our approach to accommodate the specific needs of both the position and the candidate. Thank you for considering a career with us. We encourage you to regularly check for updates and explore future opportunities with DAR Engineering. Best of luck!

9edacfcf16a99588.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Fire Safety Engineer to join their team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time position is responsible for delivering technical fire and life safety engineering activities across KAUST, operating under the direction of the Fire Safety Engineering Lead. The role supports KAUST's delegated Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) governance framework. Key Responsibilities Conduct technical reviews, field assessments, inspections, compliance verification, fire risk assessments, and technical investigations within approved KAUST procedures and delegated authorities. Prepare technical recommendations for review and approval through the Lead, Fire Safety Engineer, and the Health and Safety Manager, as applicable. Support compliance with Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and KAUST requirements. Maintain audit-ready evidence, verify fire protection system performance, and support Civil Defense-related documentation and inspections where applicable. Escalate significant fire and life safety risks. Conduct fire and life safety engineering reviews, assessments, inspections, and field verifications. Review fire safety requirements for new construction, renovations, research facilities, high-hazard areas, and fire protection systems. Review and maintain fire safety documentation, drawings, test certificates, inspection records, ITM records, and deficiency closure evidence. Coordinate with Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, Fire & Emergency Services, and other stakeholders to resolve fire safety issues. Provide technical assurance for Inspection, Testing & Maintenance (ITM) of fire protection systems and monitor corrective actions. Participate in testing, commissioning, acceptance, and functional verification of fire alarms, suppression systems, smoke control, passive fire protection, fire doors, barriers, and egress systems. Support investigations of fire incidents, unwanted alarms, system failures, and impairments, including root cause analysis and corrective actions. Compliance and Standards The Fire Safety Engineer will ensure adherence to Saudi Civil Defense requirements, Saudi Building Code (SBC), National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), International Fire Code (IFC), and internal KAUST requirements. The position involves collaboration with various internal and external stakeholders including Projects, Facilities, contractors, consultants, and Fire & Emergency Services. Perform design verification, material selection, tolerance evaluation, and value-engineering assessments in line with applicable requirements. Process engineering changes, controlled document updates, and product lifecycle records in the PLM or approved document-control system. Coordinate with Manufacturing on manufacturability, route cards, tooling, process instructions, assembly, and testing requirements. Support Procurement with material specifications, technical bid evaluations, vendor clarifications, and certification or traceability requirements. Work with Quality on ITPs, acceptance criteria, nonconformities, CAPA, root-cause analysis, and audit evidence. Apply API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B requirements and relevant ASME, NACE, ISO, and customer specifications. Support API monogram, customer, internal, and external audits and maintain complete, current, and traceable engineering records. Identify design, quality, lead-time, and cost improvements and share lessons learned with engineering and operational teams. Accountabilities Accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery of assigned drawings, models, calculations, BOMs, specifications, and verification records. Compliance of assigned engineering outputs with approved design inputs, API standards, customer requirements, and document-control procedures. Effective technical support for quotations, customer inquiries, manufacturing, procurement, quality, and field-service requirements. Timely identification and escalation of design risk, nonconformity, feasibility constraints, technical deviations, and approval requirements. Practical knowledge of API 6A, 16A, 16C, 5CT, and 5B, with awareness of ASME, NACE MR0175/ISO 15156, ISO, and customer requirements. Good understanding of CNC machining, welding, assembly, hydrostatic and gas testing, material selection, certification, and traceability. Strong proficiency in 3D CAD software such as SolidWorks or Inventor and familiarity with engineering calculation or FEA tools. 9efb5c67432f31e6.description: Job Announcement – Production Supervisor A company specializing in the retail sector announces a vacancy for a Production Supervisor to join the team and oversee production operations in the garment factory, ensure product quality and production line efficiency, and achieve production targets in accordance with approved standards, while adhering to production and shipping schedules. 9e682660983fafcb.job_title: Assistant Manager - DevCo Strategic Planning and Performance
9e682660983fafcb.description: Job description: What We Offer Joining Red Sea Global [DEVCO]means becoming part of a visionary company dedicated to sustainable development and innovation in the projects we deliver. We foster an inclusive culture that values diversity, supports professional development, and encourages collaboration across all levels. As a member of our TPMO leadership team, you will have the opportunity to influence key strategic decisions, drive meaningful change, and contribute to high-impact projects that shape the future of the region. Position Title: Assistant Manager - DevCo Strategic Planning and Performance Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia Division: Projects Delivery Department: Technical Project Management Office About the Role As the Assistant Manager for DevCo Strategic Planning and Performance, you will play a pivotal leadership role in shaping and driving the strategic direction and operational excellence of DevCo Operations within Red Sea Global. This role entails ownership of the entire strategy-to-execution chain, encompassing the formulation and maintenance of the business strategy, execution of a comprehensive strategic roadmap, oversight of the annual and three-year business planning cycles, and management of a portfolio of strategic initiatives designed to enhance performance and operational efficiency. You will serve as a key liaison between operational teams and executive management, synthesizing complex performance data into actionable insights and business decisions. Your expertise will foster a culture of continuous improvement through structured business analysis, scenario planning, and portfolio prioritization, ensuring alignment with broader Group objectives. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, periodic refresh, and review of the DevCo Operations business strategy, ensuring it is adaptive and forward-looking. Oversee the comprehensive annual and three-year business planning cycles, collaborating closely with cross-functional stakeholders to integrate financial and operational objectives. Lead the preparation, submission, and iterative review of the annual budget in partnership with Finance and Financial Planning & Analysis teams to ensure fiscal discipline and alignment with strategic goals. Maintain and continuously update the Strategic Initiatives Register, tracking progress, milestones, and benefit realization through to successful closure. Conduct detailed operational efficiency analyses, identify areas for improvement, and develop robust business cases to support enhancement initiatives. Design and manage a strategic performance framework that supports rigorous monitoring and evaluation, producing insightful Quarterly Business Review analyses to inform strategic decisions. Deliver comprehensive business analyses including options appraisal, scenario modeling, and benchmarking against industry best practices to guide strategic choices. Prepare executive-level reports, papers, and dynamic presentations that effectively translate data and analyses into clear strategic decisions for senior leadership. Ensure continuous alignment of DevCo Operations strategy, business plans, and performance metrics with the overarching Group direction and interrelated DevCo functions. Required Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or a related discipline is required. Advanced degrees or relevant certifications are advantageous. 7 to 10 years of progressive experience, with a minimum of 4 years focused on corporate strategy, business planning, performance management, business analysis, or management consulting, preferably within complex project delivery environments. Technical and Professional Skills Corporate Strategy and Strategic Planning: Expert proficiency to support strategic development and drive implementation with agility. Business Analysis and Options Appraisal: Expert capability in dissecting business problems and evaluating alternatives to recommend sound solutions. Business Planning and Portfolio Prioritisation: Advanced skills to align projects and initiatives with strategic priorities effectively. KPI Framework Design and Performance Management: Advanced expertise to develop meaningful performance metrics that drive accountability and excellence. Executive Communication and Presentation Design: Expert-level skill in articulating complex information succinctly and convincingly to senior stakeholders. Additional Requirements Excellent command of written and spoken English with strong executive writing and communication skills; proficiency in Arabic is considered advantageous. Demonstrated ability to develop analytical models and deliver high-impact executive-grade presentations. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to influence at multiple levels of the organization and work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams. Proactive problem-solving approach with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement. Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a strategic outlook.

9eaea3662f99bc0d.description: Job description . Job Purpose To perform product costing, manufacturing cost accounting, inventory valuation, and cost analysis while supporting accurate financial reporting, cost control, and informed operational decision-making in accordance with company policies and accounting standards. Key Accountability Areas Product Costing & Manufacturing Cost Control: Own product costing activities for assigned manufacturing operations, ensuring the accuracy of standard costs, Bills of Materials (BOMs), routings, labor rates, and overhead allocations. Perform standard cost roll-ups and periodic cost reviews to ensure costing reflects current manufacturing conditions. Analyze actual manufacturing costs against standard costs and investigate cost variances. Review cost absorption, material usage, labor efficiency, scrap, rework, and production overheads to ensure accurate product costing. Support cost reduction initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve manufacturing efficiency and cost performance. Inventory Accounting & Financial Reporting: Manage inventory valuation, work-in-progress (WIP), production order settlements, and manufacturing-related inventory accounting. Review material consumption, inventory movements, stock adjustments, and investigate abnormal inventory transactions. Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to manufacturing costs, inventory, cost centers, and production variances. Prepare manufacturing cost reports, inventory reconciliations, and financial analyses for management reporting. Ensure timely and accurate reporting of manufacturing financial results in accordance with company policies and accounting standards. Cost Analysis, Budgeting & Performance Monitoring: Perform detailed variance analysis for material, labor, overhead, purchase price, scrap, rework, and production efficiency. Assist in the preparation of annual budgets, forecasts, and manufacturing cost plans. Monitor actual manufacturing costs against budgets and forecasts, highlighting financial risks and recommending corrective actions. Support profitability analysis, cost-saving initiatives, and operational performance improvement projects. Provide meaningful financial insights to support production planning, capacity utilization, and operational decision-making. Manufacturing Finance Support & Business Partnering: Partner with production, warehouse, procurement, planning, engineering, and quality teams to improve cost visibility and operational performance. Provide financial analysis and costing support for new products, process improvements, and operational initiatives. Support management by explaining manufacturing cost movements, operational variances, and financial impacts. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve inventory accuracy, production reporting, and cost management practices. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing manufacturing efficiency and financial performance. Internal Controls, Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting standards, and internal controls related to manufacturing costing and inventory. Maintain accurate documentation for costing calculations, reconciliations, inventory adjustments, and financial analyses. Support internal and external audits, inventory counts, and cost audit requirements. Review and improve costing procedures, reconciliations, and financial reporting processes to strengthen operational controls. Identify opportunities to automate reporting, improve data accuracy, and enhance manufacturing finance processes through continuous improvement. Role Accountability HR Proficiency: Ability to obtain updated soft and technical skills related to the job. Delivery: Perform the planned activities to meet the operational and development targets as per delivery schedules. Utilize resources effectively to achieve objectives within efficient cost and time. Provide a periodic report formatted by detailing the deviation and execution of planned tasks. Problem-Solving: Solve any related problems arise and escalate any complex operational issues. Quality: Ensure quality requirements to develop effective quality control and processes including specifications for products or processes or related activities. Business Process Improvements: Coordinate well-defined written systems, policies, procedures, and seek automations opportunities as much as possible. Compliance: Comply to related policy and procedures and work instructions. Health, Safety, and Environment: Ensure compliance of relevant safety, quality, and environmental management procedures and controls within defined area of work activity to guarantee safety, legislative compliance, and delivery of high-quality products/services. Academic Qualification Bachelor Degree in Accounting and Finance or Any relevant field Work Experience 4 to 6 Years Technical / Functional Competencies Financial Accounting (FI) Reconciliation Financial Reporting Preferred candidate Years of experience No experience required Degree Bachelor's degree / higher diploma

9ec4c78fd5ac7514.description: About ASMO ASMO is a joint venture between DHL and Saudi Aramco, established to redefine procurement and supply chain services. The company leverages DHL’s logistics expertise and Saudi Aramco’s extensive supply chain ecosystem to provide integrated, end-to-end services. Initially focusing on Saudi Aramco and its affiliates, ASMO aims to serve industrial, energy, chemical, and petrochemical sectors across Saudi Arabia, with long-term plans to expand into the MENA region. Outbound Supervisor Role ASMO is seeking an Outbound Supervisor for its SPARK site in Buqayq, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for overseeing the safe, accurate, and efficient execution of outbound warehouse and yard processes during assigned shifts. The supervisor translates operational plans into daily execution by coordinating personnel, equipment, picking, staging, loading, dispatch activities, and system transactions. Key accountabilities include order execution, shipment accuracy, productivity, safety, quality, cut-off adherence, and timely escalation of issues. Key Responsibilities Lead daily outbound activities, including order release coordination, picking, packing (where applicable), staging, verification, loading, and dispatch confirmation. Allocate labor, Material Handling Equipment (MHE), staging space, and work priorities based on order urgency, transport schedules, cut-off times, and available capacity. Ensure correct material, quantity, condition, and documentation are prepared and shipped against approved customer orders. Control outbound exceptions such as shortages, holds, damaged material, picking discrepancies, loading issues, and transport delays, escalating promptly. Ensure Warehouse Management System (WMS) transactions are completed accurately and on time, aligning physical material movement with system status. Coordinate with inventory, inbound, yard, transport, planning, and customer service teams to resolve constraints and protect delivery commitments. Monitor outbound productivity, picking accuracy, staging backlog, loading performance, truck turnaround, and on-time dispatch. Lead shift start-up, floor control, operational problem-solving, and shift handover. Qualifications and Experience A high school diploma, technical diploma, vocational qualification, or equivalent practical background is acceptable. A bachelor’s or master’s degree is not mandatory. Candidates without a degree may be considered with at least 10 years of relevant, progressive, and verifiable warehouse or logistics experience, including substantial frontline leadership responsibility. 7–10 years of relevant warehouse, logistics, manufacturing, or industrial operations experience, with a minimum of 3 years leading or supervising frontline operational teams, is preferred. Operational competence, safety leadership, WMS capability, people supervision, inventory discipline, and measurable delivery results are prioritized. Warehouse operations, logistics, safety, MHE, WMS, Lean, or supervisory certifications are advantageous. Relevant equipment licenses are required if the role involves operating or directly controlling licensed equipment. Required Skills and Abilities Proven hands-on experience supervising picking, staging, loading, dispatch, and shipment verification in warehouse, manufacturing, industrial, or contract logistics operations. Practical experience leading frontline employees and coordinating labor, MHE, staging areas, and workload in a shift-based environment. Working experience with WMS or equivalent enterprise systems, including picking, loading, dispatch, and exception transactions. Demonstrated ability to control shipment accuracy, shortages, holds, documentation issues, safety risks, and operational backlog. Ability to use KPIs, daily management routines, and structured problem-solving to improve outbound performance.

9ec9c949f924e8e5.description: We’re Hiring | P&S Policy Administration Specialist – Group Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia We are seeking a qualified and detail-oriented P&S Policy Administration Specialist – Group to join our team in Riyadh and support group insurance policy administration and related operations. 9e6181511073c1d1.description: Job Description Join Us as a Clinical Trial Manager, managing studies locally in Saudi Arabia for one of our clients. Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation The Clinical Trial Manager is accountable for achieving the final clinical deliverable (usually clean data from evaluable patients as specified in the study protocol) within the time period specified in the contract with the customer. The Clinical Trial Manager interprets data on project issues and makes good business decisions with support from experienced team members or line manager. Works to ensure that all clinical deliverables meet the customer's time/quality/cost expectations. Maintains profitability by ensuring clinical activity is conducted within contract scope, through efficient management of the clinical team. The position involves working on projects of low to moderate complexity and as part of a team of CTMs. What You'll Do: Manage all clinical operational and quality aspects of allocated studies, of low to moderate complexity, in compliance with ICH GCP. In accordance to project specific requirements, may assume Clinical Study Manager (CSM) responsibilities on small and/or less complex projects. Develop clinical tools (e.g. Monitoring Plan, Monitoring Guidelines) in conjunction with the Data Quality Plan. Contribute to the development of the Master Action Plan (MAP) for providing clinical related documents. Ensure timely set up, organization, content and quality of the relevant sections of the Trial Master File (local and central). May participate in the design and development of CRFs, CRF guidelines, patient informed consent templates and other protocol specific documents as required. Collaborate with the project manager to prepare, organize, and present at client meetings, including bid defense and hand-off meetings. Collaborate with the clinical team and other departments as needed to meet deliverables of the project. Regularly communicate with the team and lead team meetings to ensure that timelines, resources, interactions, and quality are maintained. Responsible for the implementation and training of standardized clinical monitoring processes within the study and according to corporate standard policies. Responsible for the timely archiving of documents and study materials for the department. Ensure achievement of the final clinical deliverable within the contractual time period specified by preparing and monitoring clinical activity timelines and metrics, providing status updates to the project manager, regularly reviewing projects using tracking and management tools, implementing recovery actions, reviewing monitoring visit reports, and managing CRF collection and query resolution. Continuously monitor or co-monitors clinical trials to assess performance and ensure contractual obligations are met. In smaller regions, may routinely conduct Accompanied Field Visits (AFVs) and be accountable for project financials. May communicate with study sites regarding issues such as protocol, patient participation, case report form completion and other study-related issues. May coordinate all start-up activities and ensures that timely ethics committee and regulatory submissions (if appropriate) are addressed. Ensure that essential document quality meets the expectation of Regulatory Compliance Review. Review and follows up on all questions raised by the ethics committees. May provide input into preparation of forecast estimates for clinical activities. Responsible for clinical resource management, assignment, delegation of clinical responsibilities and identification of additional resource requirements. Desired Candidate Profile Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 5+ years). In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role. Good leadership skills, effective at mentoring and training, and capable of motivating and integrating teams Good planning and organizational skills to enable effective prioritization of workload Solid interpersonal and problem solving skills to enable working in a multicultural matrix organization Capable of working effectively in a changing environment with complex/ambiguous situations Familiarity with the practices, processes, and requirements of clinical monitoring Good judgment and decision making skills Effective oral and written communication skills, including English language proficiency Capable of evaluating workload against project budget and adjusting resources accordingly Sound financial acument and knowledge of budgeting, forecasting and fiscal management Strong attention to detail Solid understanding of relevant regulations e.g. ICH/GCP, FDA guidelines, etc. Good computer skills to effectively use automated systems and computerized applications such as Outlook, Excel, Word, etc.

Monitoring incoming bid information and communications, distributing to bid team and management, and tracking bid submissions. Support with the management of Bid Library from CVs, and templates to case studies. A collaborative working style and an ability to operate within in a fast-paced environment. Experience in construction consultancy would be a distinct advantage. MS skills – Word and PowerPoint are critical. Attention to detail essential with excellent writing skills. Flexibility and open to changing priorities.

9e119b39b091a394.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة سيارتك للتسويق الالكتروني عن مدير إعلام للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يشارك مدير الإعلام في تطوير الأهداف الإعلامية الرئيسية وتطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. يشرف الدور بشكل مباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإعلامية لضمان توافقها مع الخطط التشغيلية والأهداف الاستراتيجية، مع متابعة العمليات وضمان توفر الموارد اللازمة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الإعلامية الرئيسية للجهة، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف، والتأكد من وجود أطر ومقاييس دقيقة لمستوى تحقيقها. الإشراف العام على أداء وأعمال جميع الوحدات التنظيمية وفرق العمل، وقيادة وتوجيه ومتابعة سير العمليات والإجراءات العامة ومستوى الخدمات المقدمة، وضمان تناسقها وملاءمتها لمعايير الجودة المعتمدة. بناء علاقات استراتيجية مع شركاء العمل، مثل الجهات والمراكز الإعلامية المختلفة، وتنسيق المشاريع والجهود المشتركة والتواصل المستمر معهم. ضمان وجود قنوات تواصل داخلية فعالة تحقق مستوى عالٍ من التكامل والترابط بين جميع الوحدات التنظيمية التابعة. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير وسائط التواصل المتعددة مثل مقاطع الفيديو والنصوص الرقمية، والعمل على نشرها بالجودة المطلوبة عبر القنوات الإعلامية المختلفة، بما في ذلك قنوات التواصل الاجتماعي. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير العامة لسير العمليات الإعلامية وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة، وإحاطتها بالتحديات والمستجدات واستشارتها في القضايا الطارئة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الإعلام أو التسويق الرقمي. فهم عميق لتخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإعلامية. القدرة على تطوير الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات الإعلامية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قيادية وإشرافية قوية. قدرة ممتازة على بناء العلاقات الاستراتيجية والتواصل الفعال. مهارات في إدارة المشاريع وتنسيق الجهود المشتركة. خبرة في الإشراف على تطوير ونشر المحتوى الرقمي متعدد الوسائط. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والملخصات وتقديمها للإدارة العليا. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

9e48b65540280c6e.job_title: Supervisor HR Operations and Employee Relations
9e48b65540280c6e.description: About the Role Red Sea Global is seeking a Supervisor HR Operations and Employee Relations to join their team in Tabuk, specifically covering Umluj and Tabuk. This full-time role involves supervising HR operations and employee relations activities to ensure efficient HR service delivery, policy compliance, and effective employee support across business operations and project locations. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Company Overview Botanica, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, focuses on providing sustainable greenery across Red Sea Global’s destinations. The company integrates new species with local flora and aims to set new global benchmarks in sustainable development. Since 2020, Botanica has cultivated over 5 million plants, with a target of 30 million by 2030. Key Responsibilities Supervise day-to-day HR operations and employee relations activities. Manage employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, transfers, contract changes, leave, resignations, and offboarding. Monitor attendance, absenteeism, disciplinary cases, grievances, and employee conduct. Ensure HR processes comply with company policies, procedures, and applicable labor requirements. Support workforce mobilization, employee movements, and manpower requirements across projects. Coordinate with Recruitment, Payroll, Government Relations, Administration, and other HR functions. Support line managers in addressing employee relations and performance-related matters. Maintain accurate employee records and ensure timely updates in HR systems. Prepare HR reports and monitor operational HR KPIs. Support employee engagement, communication, and HR initiatives. Provide HR support across Red Sea and AMAALA destinations and ensure consistent HR service delivery. Identify HR operational issues and recommend practical solutions and process improvements. Support to ensure compliance with relevant employment laws, policies and procedures. Demonstrate complete understanding and awareness and adhere to all company policies and procedures as well as the company’s emergency and evacuation procedures.
